description: This file defines a custom desktop pane component for a Java Swing application supporting MDI (Multiple Document Interface) functionality and integrated scroll handling. It extends JDesktopPane to manage internal frames with cascade and tile arrangements, and includes a custom desktop manager class to handle resizing and scrollbar adaptation.

classes.name: MDIDesktopPane
classes.description: A custom desktop pane supporting multi-document interface features, including cascade and tile arrangements, and managing internal frame positioning with optional scroll bar support.

classes.name: MDIDesktopManager
classes.description: A specialized desktop manager that extends DefaultDesktopManager to handle resizing and repositioning of internal frames, and manages scroll pane interactions to provide scrollbars for the MDIDesktopPane.

methods.name: MDIDesktopPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the desktop manager and drag mode.

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Overrides to check desktop size after bounds change.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new internal frame, positioning it relative to existing frames, setting size, and updating UI elements.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a component and updates the toolbar and size.

methods.name: cascadeFrames
methods.description: Arranges internal frames in a cascade pattern.

methods.name: tileFrames
methods.description: Arranges internal frames in a tiled pattern.

methods.name: setAllSize
methods.description: Sets all size constraints to a specific Dimension.

methods.name: setAllSize
methods.description: Sets all size constraints to specified width and height.

methods.name: checkDesktopSize
methods.description: Adjusts scrollbars and desktop size if needed.
